pair_attestations.reason: This branch changed 12 workflow files in ONE way: an `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` step's `bun-version` literal went from `latest` (or from absent) to `1.3.14`. Re-read all six paired documentations: none mentions the runtime, `setup-bun\', `bun-version` or `latest` — grepped, not assumed — so none of them describes the thing that changed. `upstream-pin-watch` was read most closely because this branch also adds Bun to `upstream-pins.json`, and its prose is tenant-agnostic by design: it names no pin, gives no count, and says a new tenant is 'a registry row and a call — never a second diagram'. Adding a row is what it prescribes, so the prose holds a fortiori. Bean `3ozg`.
